exposure: surgery performed outside the regular day shift
outcome: perioperative complications like nausea or vomiting
cohort: 2508 patients receiving surgery between January 2011 and February 2016 in a tertiary referral centre (university departments of gynaecology and obstetrics)
finding: Caesarean section and minimal invasive procedures were associated with the highest pain scores, and younger age, surgery outside regular shifts, chronic pain, and surgical approach influenced postoperative pain intensity.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with the highest pain scores in the study.
